quest.title: Recuperating From a Severe Illness
quest.description: As Anna has been recovering from her illness, she's finally started playing all around the city again. However, Anthony can't seem to find her anywhere...

dialogues.speaker: Anthony
dialogues.text: Oh, that girl, where has she run off to this time...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Anna's gone out to play again?

dialogues.speaker: Anthony
dialogues.text: Really, how can you be so unperturbed?

dialogues.speaker: Anthony
dialogues.text: Anna's become less and less obedient. I turn around for one second, and she just slips away.

dialogues.speaker: Anthony
dialogues.text: She hasn't fully recovered yet! Please help me find her.

response.speaker: Anthony
response.text: Ah, right. Anna always told me that she wanted to see the statue of the Anemo Archon.

response.speaker: Anthony
response.text: I remember that Sister Grace goes there often.

response.speaker: Anthony
response.text: You could go ask her first. Maybe she's noticed something...

response.speaker: Anthony
response.text: Of course. I even searched outside the city!

response.speaker: Anthony
response.text: But still, no luck. So I could only turn to you.

choices.text: What does she like to eat?

response.speaker: Anthony
response.text: Well, she's fond of... Hey! Haven't I told you to stop treating her like a cat?

response.speaker: Anthony
response.text: In any case, she loves all sorts of food, more than I can count.

response.speaker: Anthony
response.text: Okay, I'm counting on you to look for her. I'll be waiting for you here. I'm so tired, I feel like I could collapse...

dialogues.speaker: Anna
dialogues.text: So you really can see all of Mondstadt from up here...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Don't catch a cold, now.

dialogues.speaker: Anna
dialogues.text: Wah! You gave me a fright, where'd you come from?

dialogues.speaker: Anna
dialogues.text: I bet my brother's looking for me again. Haha, I knew he wouldn't find me here.

dialogues.speaker: Anna
dialogues.text: I know, I know. I get it, I'll go back in a while. I won't make him worry.

dialogues.speaker: Anthony
dialogues.text: Have you found Anna already?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: She's on the Anemo Archon statue's hand.

dialogues.speaker: Anthony
dialogues.text: The—The Anemo Archon statue's hand? How did she even get up there?

dialogues.speaker: Anthony
dialogues.text: I'll head there immediately, get her to come down, and scold her a bit.

dialogues.speaker: Anthony
dialogues.text: My thanks. Please, take these.

dialogues.speaker: Grace
dialogues.text: Hasn't this child always been ill? So how...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Have you seen a certain girl...

dialogues.speaker: Grace
dialogues.text: Ha... You must be referring to Anna. Look up — she's in the hands of the Anemo Archon statue.

dialogues.speaker: Grace
dialogues.text: Honestly, I was quite stunned when she ran past me. I mean, she's been ill all this time, so where did she get this much energy from?

dialogues.speaker: Grace
dialogues.text: By the time I recovered, she'd already gone all the way up to the Anemo Archon statue's hands.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You're... not angry?

dialogues.speaker: Grace
dialogues.text: Angry? Well, I was a little angry. But that child has always been tormented by her sickness...

dialogues.speaker: Grace
dialogues.text: Seeing her healthy like this... How do I say this? I just can't get angry.

dialogues.speaker: Grace
dialogues.text: That said, the wind is very strong up there. I hope she doesn't catch a cold...

dialogues.speaker: Anna
dialogues.text: So you really can see all of Mondstadt from up here...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Don't catch a cold, now.

dialogues.speaker: Anna
dialogues.text: Wah! You gave me a scare. Where did you pop out from, and how did you find me?

dialogues.speaker: Anna
dialogues.text: I was so sure no one would find me here...

dialogues.speaker: Anna
dialogues.text: Ah, right. Sister Grace must have told you where I am. She's always around here.

dialogues.speaker: Anna
dialogues.text: A lot of the medicine I've taken in the past were sent over by her.

dialogues.speaker: Anna
dialogues.text: Sister Grace is a wonderful person... But I don't want to stay in Mondstadt forever.

dialogues.speaker: Anna
dialogues.text: Alright, I know my brother's looking for me. I'll head back soon, so he doesn't worry.

dialogues.speaker: Anthony
dialogues.text: Have you managed to find Anna?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: She's on the Anemo Archon statue's hand.

dialogues.speaker: Anthony
dialogues.text: The—The Anemo Archon statue's hand? How did she even get up there?

dialogues.speaker: Anthony
dialogues.text: Ah, we've made trouble for Sister Grace again. I mean, we always do, but...

dialogues.speaker: Anthony
dialogues.text: I'll head there immediately, get her to come down, and scold her a bit.

dialogues.speaker: Anthony
dialogues.text: My thanks. Please, take these.

dialogues.speaker: Anthony
dialogues.text: Where's Anna gone this time? How did I not see before that she could be this much of a handful?

dialogues.speaker: Anna
dialogues.text: If I had a wind glider, I'd try flying from up here, just to see how it feels.

dialogues.speaker: Grace
dialogues.text: The wind is very strong up here. I hope that child doesn't catch a cold...
